title: MatD3 materials database (HybriD3)

author.name: HybriD3-database
author.field: Materials science: hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites, experimental and computed material properties

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A web database where researchers sign in, add property datasets for a material system (with reference, property, unit, sample type, data points and attached files), search and compare existing datasets, and have other staff members verify them. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
